title: The move tutors: res/field/shops/move_tutors.json
description: The four tutors who teach moves for shards, shops 243 to 246, in the order of MOVE_TUTOR_SHOP_ITEMS in src/ov036/scrcmd_shop.c, which is the order of their words in a species' personal data. A move's place in its tutor's list is its bit in that word, so tools/data/species_data.py reads the lists from here to pack each species' learnset.by_tutor: a species learns a tutor's move only when its data lists it, and a move taken out of a list must leave the species' lists too. The matching build keeps its C tables; Paper White 2's build writes them from this file (tools/data/shop_data.py header, paperwhite2/shops_config.h), for the tutors and the Pokédex. A string value is the name of a constant from generated/ or include/constants/.

shop.description: The shop's ID, as global script 2280 gives it

name.description: Where the tutor is, for people and editors; the game doesn't read it

shard.description: The shard the tutor takes (MOVE_TUTOR_CURRENCY_ITEMS in scrcmd_shop.c; the packer checks it)

moves.description: The moves by their bit in the tutor's word, at least one and at most 32

price.description: Its price in shards, which the Bag holds at most 999 of

menu_position.description: Its place in the tutor's menu, from 0; the list's places are 0 to its length less one, each once
